# Swadhu Nadan Acharukal

> Swadhu Nadan Acharukal is an FSSAI-registered (Reg No: 21325176000637), home-based food business in Thodupuzha, Idukki district, Kerala, India, making authentic homemade Kerala (nadan) pickles in small batches using traditional family recipes, with no added artificial preservatives. Orders are placed directly on WhatsApp (+91 94959 72251). Delivery is free within Thodupuzha, with parcel delivery across Kerala and courier shipping to other Indian states based on serviceability.

Key facts:

- Family-run kitchen in Thodupuzha; recipes prepared by the women of the household, with the next generation handling sourcing, packing, and delivery
- Fourteen products in 250g, 500g, and 1kg bottles (selected varieties also in 100g); prices range from ₹50 to ₹1000 per bottle
- Shelf life: up to 6 months unopened; consume within 45 days after opening; store in a cool, dry place and use a dry spoon
- Spice level: medium to spicy, Kerala homemade style
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
- Google Reviews rating: 5.0 (122 reviews)
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 94959 72251, email miniswadhupickles@gmail.com

## Products

- [Pickle collection](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/products.html): All fourteen pickles with prices, sizes, and WhatsApp ordering
- [Price list](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/price-list.html): Complete price table for every product and bottle size
- [Mango Pickle](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/mango-pickle-kerala.html): Hand-cut raw mango with sun-dried spices in gingelly oil; 250g ₹60, 500g ₹120, 1kg ₹240
- [Lemon Pickle](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/lemon-pickle-kerala.html): Salt-cured lemons with roasted masala; 250g ₹60, 500g ₹120, 1kg ₹240
- [Gooseberry (Amla) Pickle](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/gooseberry-pickle-kerala.html): Tart amla in roasted Kerala spice masala; 250g ₹60, 500g ₹120, 1kg ₹240
- [Fish Pickle](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/fish-pickle-kerala.html): Fresh fish fried firm in a roasted spice base; 100g ₹100, 250g ₹225, 500g ₹450, 1kg ₹900
- [Beef Pickle](https://swadhunadanacharukal.com/beef-pickle-kerala.html): Tender beef with pepper, chilli, and nadan masala; 100g ₹100, 250g ₹250, 500g ₹500, 1kg ₹1000
- Tender Mango Pickle (Kanni Manga): whole baby mangoes in brine and spice; 250g ₹130, 500g ₹260, 1kg ₹500
- Natholi Fish Pickle (Anchovy): small anchovies fried and pickled nadan style; 100g ₹75, 250g ₹160, 500g ₹320, 1kg ₹640
- Chicken Pickle: 100g ₹100, 250g ₹225, 500g ₹450, 1kg ₹900
- Garlic Pickle (Veluthulli): 100g ₹50, 250g ₹125, 500g ₹250, 1kg ₹500
- Dates with Lemon Pickle: 250g ₹125, 500g ₹250, 1kg ₹500
- Jathikka Pickle (Nutmeg): 250g ₹75, 500g ₹150, 1kg ₹300
- Carrot with Mango Pickle: 250g ₹80, 500g ₹160, 1kg ₹320
- Beetroot Pickle: 250g ₹80, 500g ₹160, 1kg ₹320
- Dates Pickle: 250g ₹200, 500g ₹400, 1kg ₹800
